what: AMD designs CPUs (Ryzen for PCs, EPYC for servers) and graphics and AI accelerators (Radeon, Instinct). It also makes the chips inside PlayStation and Xbox consoles. Like NVIDIA, it relies on TSMC to manufacture.
customers: Cloud providers and large companies, PC makers, Sony and Microsoft (consoles), and AI companies such as OpenAI and Meta.
money: EPYC server CPUs and Instinct AI accelerators
console chips, graphics cards and Xilinx chips for industry and cars
moat: Competitive CPU designs that have taken server share from Intel, and the only serious alternative to NVIDIA in AI GPUs.
risks: AMD's AI software still trails NVIDIA's CUDA
